summary: Frontend-only test of the redesigned Floors & Access step (step 2) of the BookingWizard. Verified 3-button Ground/Stairs/Lift access selectors for both pickup and dropoff, purple-selected styling, conditional floor dropdown when Stairs is chosen, gating logic on the Continue button, and end-to-end booking submission with correct persistence.
tests_executed: Access selector: all 6 testids (access-{ground,stairs,lift}-{pickup,dropoff}) visible and clickable on step 2. Selected button shows bg-primary (purple).
Floor conditional: floor-pickup / floor-dropoff hidden initially; appear only when access==='stairs'; hidden again when switched to Ground/Lift.

Gating: Continue disabled with nothing selected; disabled with only pickup=Ground; disabled with pickup=Ground + dropoff=Stairs (no floor); enabled with pickup=Ground + dropoff=Ground; enabled with pickup=Lift + dropoff=Stairs+3rd+.

End-to-end booking as customer@example.com / Customer#2026: addresses SW1A -> E16 2FR via option-0, pickup=Lift, dropoff=Stairs + 3rd+ floor, date+time, small van, items text + 1 photo, name/phone/notes, Confirm. Toast 'Booking created' shown, navigated to /jobs.
Persistence via GET /api/bookings: latest booking has pickup_lift=true, pickup_floor=0, dropoff_lift=false, dropoff_floor=3 (matches expectations).
critical_code_review_comments: Minor: React warning 'Select is changing from uncontrolled to controlled' when Stairs is picked and floor is still 0. In AccessPicker the Select uses value={floor >= 1 ? String(floor) : undefined}; consider passing an empty string or defaultValue consistently to avoid the warning.
seed_data_creation: One booking MWV3BF4AD59 created for customer@example.com (London SW1A 1AA -> London E16 2FR).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Floors & access step 2 in /app/frontend/src/components/BookingWizard.jsx uses AccessPicker with testids access-{ground|stairs|lift}-{pickup|dropoff} and floor-{pickup|dropoff}. Backend BookingInput persists pickup_floor/dropoff_floor/pickup_lift/dropoff_lift correctly. Auth modal defaults to Register — testing existing users requires clicking data-testid=auth-toggle first.
